Here, Defendants should be able to answer paragraphs 30 and 46 from the personal knowledge of Defendant Rawls. If they find

Based on the foregoing, we will issue an order requiring Defendants to file an amended answer with responses that conform to the
pleading requirements of Rule 8(b). * * *
NOTES AND QUESTIONS
1. WHY WAS MOVING FOR JUDGMENT ON THE PLEADINGS STRATEGICALLY ADVANTAGEOUS TO THE PLAINTIFF?
2.How does a Rule 12(c) motion differ from a Rule 12(f) motion to strike a defense from defendant’s responsive leading?
3.How does a Rule 12(c) motion differ from a Rule 12(b)(6) motion? Does either motion depend on the truth of the allegations?
